description: This file defines the SettingsFragment class which extends Fragment, representing a settings screen in an Android app. It inflates the layout resource 'fragment_settings' when the view is created.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass representing the settings screen where users can configure the app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overridden method to create and return the view hierarchy associated with the fragment. It inflates the 'fragment_settings' layout.
